results.title: The Child
results.overview: Thirty-seven-year-old Zane and Kaspars seem to have it all – love, careers, a home, and shared hobbies. Still, for a decade, they have been unable to have a child. After trying fertility clinics, diets, churches, and healers, Kaspars is slowly coming to terms with the idea that life can be fulfilling even without children. Meanwhile, Zane cannot accept the thought of not becoming a mother and is ready to go to any lengths to make it happen.

results.title: My Worst Enemy
results.overview: Valeria and her former high school classmates reunite twenty-five years later at the place where they shared their last unforgettable summer. During the reunion, old rivalries resurface, leading them into hilarious situations where they will discover the true value of friendship and the weight of the past on the present.

results.title: Des policiers à la fac
results.overview: In Amiens, 50 police officers attend sociology classes to rethink their profession, their relationship with the public and approaches to crime prevention. Over the course of a year, this documentary follows their experience in an unusual university programme launched through a partnership between the University of Picardie Jules Verne and the National Police Academy.

results.title: Mystery Wrestling x ChocoPro 2
results.overview: Mystery Wrestling x ChocoPro 2 was a collaboration between Mystery Wrestling and Chocopro that aired on 3.20.26

results.title: Love Reins at Christmas
results.overview: A widowed mother, Grace Guidry, is struggling to keep her family farm running. Throughout the holiday season, she must navigate the immense challenges of farm life and the complexities of finding hope and love again.

results.title: Dual Action
results.overview: Dual Action is a short story about a dying gangster, confronted by two mysterious figures in his final moments. It's sort of a Reservoir Dogs meets Christmas Carol type of story, where the main character is forced to face his own mortality and define the meaning of life. He's tormented by guilt and repentance and must come to term with who he really is. It's a fun twist on the gangster genre.

results.title: Il était une fois... "As bestas"
results.overview: Inspired by a true story, "As bestas", the sixth feature film by Rodrigo Sorogoyen ("Los años nuevos"), enjoyed unexpected box-office success upon its release. The story behind a hit, where thriller elements blend with rural life to reflect contemporary anxieties.

results.title: Jackrabbit
results.overview: When a coal miner in 1930s Utah hides the loss of his job from his family, the quiet deception sets off a slow-burning collapse.

results.title: The Lounge
results.overview: Unfairly overlooked employee Liz wants to become a successful corporate creature.

results.title: Triesverse: Cataclysm
results.overview: Part one of a two-part finale. Daniel Chapman is back, and this time he's brought company. With his rebooted mission to bring the Last Reality to fruition in progress, Izz Fury's newly-formed Reality Warriors must band together to put an end to his deluded antics. The stakes have never been higher - the Triesverse ends here.

results.title: Mother, Algorithm
results.overview: POV: your son goes viral… on your influencer bestie’s page. And now the whole internet thinks she’s his mom.

results.title: EMULSION
results.overview: Once born from the same matter, two forms slowly grow into vastly different beings, suspended between attraction and resistance.  As they merge and separate, intimacy becomes an unstable state where closeness and individuality struggle to coexist.

results.title: Der Thüringenkrimi - Gerechtigkeit
results.overview: The dead woman is the controversial family court judge Sophie Nöll. Chief Inspector Moritz Herbst therefore doubts that it was an accident. Mala quickly recognizes signs of a crime. Those who were severely affected by Nöll's judgments are now suspects.

results.title: GunBlade & Me
results.overview: An obsessed, washed-up Sydney filmmaker sets out to uncover what led to the cancellation of his viral high school web series, GunBlade Adventures.

results.title: TJPW Texas Stampede in Austin ~ Day 1
results.original_title: TJPW Texas Stampede in Austin ~ Day 1
results.overview: Texas Stampede in Austin ~ Day 1 was a professional wrestling event promoted by Tokyo Joshi Pro-Wrestling (TJPW), held on March 17, 2026 at Palmer Events Center in Austin, Texas, USA.

results.title: Raw Tooth
results.overview: Twelve-year-old Anya discovers a mysterious stranger in her secret hideout after another quarrel with her mother. A stranger who has settled in an abandoned house next door reveals to the girl a fantastic world that was hidden in the routine of summer cottage life. However, not everyone is ready to understand her friendship with an adult man, who obviously has something to hide. Anya is also shocked and disappointed when it turns out that she is not the only one — the mysterious stranger also communicates with her friend Amaranta, also gives her gifts and tells stories. They are angry at him and at each other. The stranger is both their main secret and a bone of contention.

results.title: Iggy the Eagle
results.overview: Every night, a young eagle named Iggy dreams of flying alongside his imaginary brother, Felix. In reality, Iggy lives in a technically advanced society of birds so civilized, they all forgot how to fly. Iggy is being raised by his highly responsible Mom and a slightly rebellious, oldschool Dad. When Iggy meets his new aviation-crazy classmate Eve, he finally gets the courage to confront his dreams, discovers the true nature of Felix… and spreads his wings in the real world for the very first time.

results.title: Solitary Dialogues
results.overview: Torn between confessing his love to Van and the fear of ruining their friendship, Aren drifts through the Parisian night. An encounter with Théo, a former lover, rekindles buried emotions and compels him to redefine the true meaning of love.

results.title: Dragonfly
results.overview: Nohemí and Mary are two women resisting structural violence in Ciudad Juárez. United by pain and hope, both mothers find inspiration to move their families forward. The dragonfly, a symbol they share, embodies their resilience and capacity for change.
